title: Arc Raiders could get a permanent PvE mode 🤖
subject: arcraiders
description:
Would you play Arc Raiders in a PvE-only mode? 👇

Embark Studios CEO Patrick Söderlund told The Game Business that Arc Raiders now has an audience big enough to cater to both PvP and PvE players. In a PvE matchmaking test, almost 50% of rounds were played on PvE servers. A permanent PvE mode has not been officially confirmed.

Sources: The Game Business interview via GameRiv (Nov 5, 2026), GamesRadar+ (Nov 6, 2026)
Game footage © Embark Studios.

scenes.text: Arc Raiders could get a permanent PvE mode.
Embark CEO Patrick Söderlund told The Game Business the audience is now big enough to serve both camps.
In his words, they can't ignore the PvE camp completely.
Embark already ran a PvE matchmaking test, and executive producer Aleksander Grøndal said almost 50% of rounds went to PvE servers.
Feedback was mixed, and nothing is confirmed yet.
For now, Arc Raiders stays a PvPvE extraction shooter on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series X|S.
